summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for Synalloy Corporation for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: The document contains Synalloy Corporation's consolidated financial statements, reporting Net Income of $20.2 million for 2021 and a Net Loss of $27.3 million for 2020. However, it pertains to Synalloy Corporation rather than Ascent Industries Co. and covers the 2021 fiscal year rather than the 2022–2024 period required. This document contains no data regarding Ascent Industries Co.'s Net Profit from Continuing Operations and contributes nothing to the requested trend analysis.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for Ascent Industries Co. (formerly Synalloy Corporation) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: This document provides the audited financial results for 2022, reporting Consolidated Net Income of $22.1 million (compared to $20.2 million in 2021). Note 4 clarifies that the Palmer business, though held for sale, was reported within continuing operations rather than as discontinued operations, aligning the reported Net Income with the "Net Profit from Continuing Operations" metric requested. However, as this is the 2022 fiscal year report, it does not contain data for 2023 or 2024, contributing only the first year of the three-year trend required by the task.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: This document supplies the 2023 Net Loss from Continuing Operations of $34.2 million and includes the 2022 comparative Net Income from Continuing Operations of $17.6 million, enabling the assessment of the 2022–2023 profit trend. The report distinguishes continuing operations from discontinued operations (Munhall facility closure and SPT divestiture), ensuring the profit figures align with the task's specific metric requirements. It does not contain financial results for 2024.
